steps.description: Amend plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh: change claim_coordinator_claim to use zbuild:claimed (single shared label, no machine suffix); change claim_coordinator_release to remove zbuild:claimed; add holder extraction from run-status comment on claim conflict; remove any back-reference source of core/claim/claim.sh (circular dependency; also eliminates the _ccgl_plugin_dir=$(cd ...) subshell)
Edit scripts/lib/run-status-render.sh: add <!-- zbuild-holder: CI_URL --> (CI) or <!-- zbuild-holder: run_id=X machine=H --> (local) in rsc_render_header after the run_id marker printf

Create core/claim/claim.sh: thin wiring bridge; source plugin.sh using $\_ZBUILD\_ROOT (not $(cd ...) subshell); zbuild_claim_build_holder uses ${HOSTNAME} bash variable (not external hostname); zbuild_claim_acquire calls _ccgl_read_labels/_ccgl_add_label/_ccgl_read_holder; zbuild_claim_release calls _ccgl_remove_label; graceful degradation (no issue, backend error)
Register pipeline.refused.claimed in config/event-schema.json following the pattern of pipeline.refused.issue_locked
Add core/claim/claim.sh to config/shape-change-paths.txt so future changes to the claim bridge trigger the shape floor

Wire core/claim/claim.sh into runner.sh: source at top; call zbuild_claim_build_holder before sidecar spawn; call zbuild_claim_acquire after zbuild_issue_lock_acquire; emit event + print holder + return 1 on refusal; call zbuild_claim_release in _runner_abort_trap with declare -F guard

Amend docs/adr/ADR-005-claim-coordinator.md: add §1 (engine calls claim/release after admission lock and before first stage, and release in EXIT path), §2 (single zbuild:claimed label; holder in run-status comment), §3 (stale content: selection not from config/zbuild.yaml; engine now has built-in mechanism), and ## Enforced by section naming tests per statement
Amend docs/adr/ADR-059-issue-vs-run-keying.md §4: note that cross-machine exclusion is the claim coordinator's job and the admission flock stays for intra-machine serialisation
